method: Imported current exported content with existing tsx; ran validateContent(); indexed source AST line ranges. Counts deduplicated by stable ID. No production file modified.

definition.name: Ashen Compact
definition.motto: Keep the hearth. Keep the oath.

profile.description: Public hearth councils rebuild reliable workshops while frontier households contest their share of the common grain.
profile.recruitmentRationale: A balanced force centered on oath guards. Shared unit costs and access remain unchanged.

definition.name: Reedbound Council
definition.motto: No river belongs to one shore.

profile.description: Seasonal wetland assemblies bargain across the banks; drainage that benefits one village can ruin another family’s deep water.
profile.recruitmentRationale: A balanced force centered on oath guards. Shared unit costs and access remain unchanged.

definition.name: Cinder March
definition.motto: We hold what the fire spared.

profile.description: Pass wardens and mine masters rely on the same walls while disputing who should direct the coin that maintains them.
profile.recruitmentRationale: A balanced force centered on oath guards. Shared unit costs and access remain unchanged.

definition.name: Glass Tide
definition.motto: Every horizon is a promise.

profile.description: Charter towns reopen the vitrified coast’s routes while arguing over which town should pay for the next shared voyage.
profile.recruitmentRationale: A balanced force centered on oath guards. Shared unit costs and access remain unchanged.

definition.name: Iron Covenant
definition.motto: The hold endures. The valley is owed.

profile.description: Anvilheights holds and their client valleys bind craft to obligation; a durable forge does not settle what its valley is owed.
profile.recruitmentRationale: A balanced force centered on oath guards. Shared unit costs and access remain unchanged.

definition.name: Sepulchral Synod
definition.motto: No measure ends at the grave.

profile.description: The chalkland terraces keep their measured offices and disputed inheritances. Their promised supernatural logistics are not implemented.
profile.recruitmentRationale: A balanced force centered on oath guards. Shared unit costs and access remain unchanged.

definition.name: Mire Courts
definition.motto: The season returns. The court remembers.

profile.description: The Deepfen’s elder seasonal courts balance patient household rights against their former tenants’ growing independence.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers spearmen and wayfinders over heavy cohorts or cavalry, fitting dispersed wetland watches. This grants no special movement.

definition.name: Saltwind Remnant
definition.motto: A keel is pledged only once.

profile.description: Surviving charter households contest the debts of the old League while restoring coastal livelihood on smaller, accountable pledges.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers oath guards with spear and scouting support for scattered landing places; ships still require ordinary navigation and harbors.

definition.name: Wardhall Remnant
definition.motto: Let the work stand witness.

profile.description: Wardhall’s surviving work halls dispute whether rebuilding the plains requires the old Throne’s authority or merely its engineering discipline.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers spearmen and heavy infantry for a deliberate defensive line. No magical nullification or hidden defensive bonus is granted.

definition.name: Rimehorn Clans
definition.motto: Share the shelter. Answer the horn.

profile.description: High-cold shelter clans balance common winter stores against the autonomy of distant households and their seasonal gatherings.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers oath guards supported by spears and heavy infantry, keeping a dependable core without exclusive troops.

definition.name: Sable Steppe
definition.motto: The road moves with the camp.

profile.description: Mobile camp assemblies negotiate grazing claims and road access without agreeing that a fixed town should speak for every camp.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers cavalry with wayfinder and spear support. Mounted companies retain their real recruitment, upkeep and armor tradeoffs.

definition.name: Morrow Spore
definition.motto: What falls shall feed what follows.

profile.description: Underwood households share living records and managed growth while disputing how much of the common forest each settlement may cut.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers wayfinders with guard and spear support for dispersed woodland holdings. Forest affinity does not remove terrain costs.

definition.name: Cistern Assembly
definition.motto: Read the measure. Share the draw.

profile.description: Well keepers, gardeners and caravan households pool dry-country maintenance while disputing whether an inherited draw outweighs a newcomer’s work.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers spearmen and guards to protect carefully improved dryland stops. Water measures grant no free irrigation or supplies.

definition.name: Unsealed Companies
definition.motto: The living make their own terms.

profile.description: Veterans and road-town households reject ancestral oath-debt while arguing over who may commit the coin earned by living workers.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers spears and mounted escorts within a varied paid force. No mercenary income, portable town or extra loot is granted.

definition.name: Lantern Hospices
definition.motto: Keep a place beside the lamp.

profile.description: Care-house towns protect clean stores and refuge while attendants contest governors who turn emergency quarantine into permanent exclusion.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers guards with spear and heavy support to escort supplies and protect refit bases. Care grants no free healing or disease immunity.

definition.name: Cairnwing Concord
definition.motto: No ledge stands without the lift.

profile.description: Feathered cairnfolk and human lift-port households share escarpment approaches while upper councils and lower workers dispute who sustains them.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers spear watches and wayfinders for difficult approaches. Folded feathers confer no flight; every formation uses ordinary ground movement.

definition.name: Red Sluice Directorate
definition.motto: Count the harvest. Answer the banks.

profile.description: Canal labor boards maintain wetland works while outlying households challenge emergency schedules that protect the center at their expense.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers spear and heavy-infantry lines to protect costly fixed works. Paid cultivation cannot redirect rivers or flood enemies.

definition.name: Velvet Meridian
definition.motto: A measure is not the final word.

profile.description: Weavers and observatory schools trade measured knowledge while public observers challenge patrons who buy exclusive interpretations.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers wayfinders with balanced escorts for guarded learning and exchange. No prediction, espionage or hidden-map knowledge is granted.

definition.name: Brine Choir
definition.motto: Let every shore be heard.

profile.description: Brinefolk pool settlements and human shore households answer proposals together while disputing whether permanent quays enclose shared rights.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers guards and spears to secure shore works and crossings. All peoples require paid ships and ordinary embarkation; no amphibious access.

definition.name: Emberwake Convocation
definition.motto: Keep the seed. Account for the fire.

profile.description: Seed keepers and kiln congregations rebuild ash-country livelihoods while resident gardeners contest teachers who promise renewal through loss.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers guards and heavy infantry with survey support for working parties. Ash-country knowledge grants no flame attacks or scorched-earth bonus.

definition.name: Underhush Exchange
definition.motto: Leave room for those who dwell.

profile.description: Burrowfolk gallery wards and surface traders bargain over smoke, vibration and repair duties without agreeing that a market lease may silence its residents.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers compact guards and spear watches for defended exchange towns. Entrances grant no tunnel shortcuts, tremor sight or second map.

definition.name: Vesper Court
definition.motto: Hospitality must have an ending.

profile.description: Vampiric patrons and living valley households maintain shuttered woodland estates while tenants demand the right to end inherited blood provisions.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers costly heavy retainers and mounted escorts. Living and vampiric officers share paid upkeep and refit; no life-steal, resurrection or night bonus.

definition.name: Manytrack Moot
definition.motto: Unlike tracks may share a road.

profile.description: Speaking horned and furred lineages join human households at a forest-steppe boundary where new fences divide routes that unlike bodies still share.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers wayfinders and spear escorts for dispersed holdings. Different bodies receive no hidden movement, beast mounts or free reconnaissance.

definition.name: Margin Observance
definition.motto: Keep the gap beside the record.

profile.description: Archive custodians and their supply households preserve disputed records while arguing over the cost and danger of opening what earlier keepers sealed.
profile.recruitmentRationale: Prefers wayfinders backed by ordinary defenders for costly frontier study. Preserved mysteries grant no spells or victory shortcut.

definition.name: Ash pike company
definition.description: Affordable line troops whose long pikes reach beyond the front rank.

definition.name: Cinder plate cohort
definition.description: Well-armored veterans with strong morale. Their heavy kit slows the entire marching column.

definition.name: Charter outriders
definition.description: Fast, hard-hitting mounted companies. High initiative rewards flanking, but light armor makes prolonged fighting costly.

definition.name: Charter transport
definition.description: Carries up to eight land formations per surviving transport formation. Lightly armed; escorts protect its passengers. Ocean navigation unlocks deep-water passage.

definition.name: Coastwatch galley
definition.description: Fast coastal escorts with ranged crews. Shallow-draft galleys cannot enter deep ocean, even after Ocean navigation; they carry no land formations.

definition.name: Deepwake warship
definition.description: Heavy ocean-going escorts with armored hulls and longer-ranged crews. Expensive to maintain and slower than galleys; they carry no land formations.

definition.name: Reed skirmishers
definition.description: Light missile companies move quickly and strike early from the second rank. Fragile in a prolonged melee; they trade a wayfinder’s scouting reach for stronger fighting.

definition.name: Witness arbalesters
definition.description: Workshop-trained bow crews deliver powerful volleys from the rear rank. Slow to take the initiative and vulnerable when their protecting line collapses.

definition.name: Kiln halberdiers
definition.description: Armored polearm companies combine strong blows with second-rank reach. Their heavy equipment slows a column, and they cost more to maintain than ash pikes.

definition.name: Road lancers
definition.description: Charter-backed armored riders deliver heavy melee blows with high initiative. Slower and costlier than outriders, they provide a durable mounted assault company.

definition.name: Hearthgrain
definition.description: Wild grainlands support granges, provisions and civic storehouses.

definition.name: Ironstone
definition.description: Iron-bearing stone supplies armor training and heavy civic works.

definition.name: Red copper
definition.description: Copper veins supply fittings, missile equipment and precision tools.

definition.name: White salt
definition.description: Salt preserves provisions and underpins trading charters.

definition.name: Heartwood
definition.description: Dense straight timber serves engineering, shields and settlement workshops.

definition.name: Steppe horses
definition.description: Wild herds support remount yards and mobile military training.

definition.name: Witness silver
definition.description: Pale silver funds advanced charters and exacting civic instruments.

definition.name: Ashglass
definition.description: Vitrified Ashfall deposits preserve arcane traces for advanced civic and military study.

definition.name: Terraced fields
definition.description: Cultivated field steps add 2 food. Springs add 1 more food; waterlogging costs 1 food.

definition.name: Managed woodlot
definition.description: Selective woodland use adds 2 industry and 1 food. Old growth adds 1 knowledge; glass fragments cost 1 industry.

definition.name: Measured quarry
definition.description: Stone cutting adds 3 industry but costs 1 food. Ore adds 1 industry; waterlogging costs 1 industry.

definition.name: Reedworks
definition.description: Wetland beds add 1 food, 1 industry and 1 coin. Peat adds 1 industry; glass fragments cost 1 coin.

definition.name: Shore fishery
definition.description: A shallow-water fishery adds 2 food and 1 coin. Rich shoals add 1 food; glass fragments cost 1 coin.

definition.name: Spring garden
definition.description: A fresh-water garden adds 3 food but costs 1 industry. Its spring adds 1 coin; waterlogging costs 1 food. Requires a spring on habitable land.

definition.name: Polder
definition.description: Sluiced wetland adds 4 food and 1 industry but costs 1 coin. Peat adds 1 industry; old growth costs 1 knowledge and Ashfall glass costs 1 food. Natural features remain intact.

definition.name: Grove archive
definition.description: Protected woodland records add 1 industry and 2 knowledge. Old growth adds 1 knowledge; peat gathering restrictions cost 1 industry. Requires old-growth woodland.

definition.name: Oreworks
definition.description: A crane-served seam adds 4 industry but costs 1 food and 1 coin. Ore adds 1 industry; waterlogging costs 2 industry. Requires a mineral seam, not merely a hill.

definition.name: Tide observatory
definition.description: A shallow-water observing station adds 3 knowledge and 1 coin, not a fishery’s food. Ashfall glass adds 1 knowledge; protected rich shoals cost 1 coin.

definition.name: Hearthgrain grange
definition.description: Work this completed site to gather 3 Hearthgrain each active turn into the realm stockpile. Requires its actual deposit; occupation and siege halt extraction.

definition.name: Ironstone mine
definition.description: Work this completed site to gather 2 Ironstone each active turn into the realm stockpile. Requires its actual deposit; occupation and siege halt extraction.

definition.name: Copper mine
definition.description: Work this completed site to gather 2 Red copper each active turn into the realm stockpile. Requires its actual deposit; occupation and siege halt extraction.

definition.name: Salt house
definition.description: Work this completed site to gather 2 White salt each active turn into the realm stockpile. Requires its actual deposit; occupation and siege halt extraction.

definition.name: Heartwood yard
definition.description: Work this completed site to gather 2 Heartwood each active turn into the realm stockpile. Requires its actual deposit; occupation and siege halt extraction.

definition.name: Remount yard
definition.description: Work this completed site to gather 1 Steppe horses each active turn into the realm stockpile. Requires its actual deposit; occupation and siege halt extraction.

definition.name: Silver mine
definition.description: Work this completed site to gather 1 Witness silver each active turn into the realm stockpile. Requires its actual deposit; occupation and siege halt extraction.

definition.name: Ashglass refinery
definition.description: Work this completed site to gather 1 Ashglass each active turn into the realm stockpile. Requires its actual deposit; occupation and siege halt extraction.

definition.name: Cinder masonry
definition.description: Reusable kiln forms strengthen hearthland workshops. Every settlement gains 2 industry before devastation, occupation and blockade penalties.

definition.name: Civic accounts
definition.description: Public ledgers reconnect the bargains once carried by the Witness Roads. Every settlement gains 1 coin and 1 knowledge before penalties; enables the Hearth Exchange.

definition.name: Coastal navigation
definition.description: Soundings and shore charts reconnect coastal hearthlands. Enables Charter harbors, transports and Coastwatch galleys; vessels can travel coastal shallows. This practical knowledge does not confer magical aptitude.

definition.name: Ocean navigation
definition.description: Deep-water charts and long-voyage rigging open the ocean. Ocean-capable transports and Deepwake warships may cross deep water; coastal galleys remain restricted to shallows.

definition.name: Seasonal stewardship
definition.description: Record planting and water-sharing obligations. Unlocks Spring gardens on fresh-water land; opens the waterworks, forestry and surveyed-estates branches. Knowledge alone does not build or work a tile.

definition.name: Sluice waterworks
definition.description: Controlled sluices support worked wetland Polders. They can feed crowded settlements, but old growth and Ashfall glass make intensive planting less productive. Physical terrain and natural features remain intact.

definition.name: Surveyed estates
definition.description: Witnessed boundary surveys add one civic progress per active settlement turn toward automatic border expansion. Claims still require connected, charted land within the settlement’s reach; siege and occupation halt expansion.

definition.name: Charter forestry
definition.description: Bind cutting rights to the preservation of living records. Unlocks Grove archives on old-growth woodland: knowledge and modest industry instead of the woodlot’s stronger extraction.

definition.name: Counterweighted cranes
definition.description: Reusable lifting frames unlock Oreworks on mineral seams. Worked Oreworks favor industry at the cost of food and coin; wet ground complicates extraction.

definition.name: Deep soundings
definition.description: Observations from the shore compare returning ships’ ocean records. Unlocks Tide observatories on coastal shallows; knowledge replaces the food-focused role of a fishery. Does not extend worker reach into deep ocean.

definition.name: Charter compact
definition.description: Recognize shared market charters. Every settlement gains 2 coin before penalties; enables the Hearth Exchange. Permanently excludes Common stewardship.

definition.name: Common stewardship
definition.description: Communal stores take priority over merchant privileges. Every settlement gains 3 food before penalties; enables the Hearth Exchange. Permanently excludes Charter compact.

definition.name: Shield cohesion
definition.description: Train formations to cover one another. Armies gain 2 armor in battle. Permanently excludes March columns.

definition.name: March columns
definition.description: Organize disciplined marching relays. Armies regain 1 additional strategic movement each turn. Permanently excludes Shield cohesion.

definition.name: Field habits
definition.description: The surviving company learns to hold formation under pressure. Adds 4 battle morale; training does not replace casualties or restore movement.

definition.name: Pressure drill
definition.description: Practice committing a line at the decisive moment. Adds 2 attack. Permanently chooses Assault over Line and Missile training.

definition.name: Breach timing
definition.description: Veterans recognize the instant a formation gives ground. Adds 3 attack and 1 initiative.

definition.name: Covering partners
definition.description: Pairs learn to shelter each other through a long engagement. Adds 1 armor. Permanently chooses Line over Assault and Missile training.

definition.name: Held line
definition.description: A company with shared battle memory keeps its ranks intact. Adds 2 armor and 4 battle morale.

definition.name: Measured sights
definition.description: A formation with a ranged weapon learns to act before an opening closes. Adds 2 initiative. Permanently chooses Missile over Assault and Line training.

definition.name: Countershot
definition.description: Experienced crews coordinate covering fire. Adds 1 range and 1 attack to an already ranged formation.

definition.name: Witnessed service
definition.description: A tested company maintains its own veteran cadre. Adds 6 battle morale and 1 armor after completing any training branch.

definition.name: Common store
definition.description: Put the root cellar under a witnessed rotation of local households. Adds 2 food before ordinary town penalties.

definition.name: Granary rotations
definition.description: Specialize the hearth in dependable provisions. Adds 3 food; permanently excludes advanced Craft and Commerce specializations.

definition.name: Seed exchange
definition.description: A city exchanges seed records and reserve stores through its market. Adds 4 food and 1 knowledge.

definition.name: Craft courts
definition.description: Give working crews a common place to settle tools, measurements and apprenticeships. Adds 2 industry.

definition.name: Kiln guilds
definition.description: Specialize the hearth in coordinated production. Adds 3 industry and 1 coin; permanently excludes advanced Provisions and Commerce specializations.

definition.name: Master workyards
definition.description: A city records skilled practice beside its working furnaces. Adds 4 industry and 2 knowledge.

definition.name: Witness counter
definition.description: Keep a public counter for the market’s obligations and payments. Adds 3 coin.

definition.name: Charter ledger
definition.description: Specialize the hearth in recorded exchange. Adds 3 coin and 2 knowledge; permanently excludes advanced Provisions and Craft specializations.

definition.name: Exchange quarter
definition.description: Witness houses and market courts sustain a city’s permanent exchange district. Adds 5 coin and 3 knowledge.

definition.name: Store pledges
definition.description: Extend Common stewardship through reciprocal reserve obligations. Every hearth gains 2 food before local penalties.

definition.name: Harvest councils
definition.description: Local stewards coordinate planting and shared repairs. Every hearth gains 2 food and 1 industry.

definition.name: Open ledgers
definition.description: Extend the Charter compact with records that can travel between markets. Every hearth gains 2 coin and 1 knowledge.

definition.name: Itinerant courts
definition.description: Travelling witnesses settle obligations across the realm. Every hearth gains 2 coin and 1 industry.

definition.name: Watched ranks
definition.description: Carry Shield cohesion into an established system of mutual watches. Every fighting formation gains 1 armor and 4 battle morale.

definition.name: Standing reserve
definition.description: Keep trained replacements and reserve equipment ready for the line. Every fighting formation gains 1 armor and 1 attack; this does not heal existing losses.

definition.name: Dispatch cells
definition.description: Extend March columns with compact groups trained to pass orders. Every fighting formation gains 2 initiative.

definition.name: Disciplined momentum
definition.description: A moving column keeps enough order to strike together. Every fighting formation gains 2 attack and 4 battle morale.

definition.name: Contained ember projection
definition.description: National Arcane Theory for Cinder thread. A personally Flame-gifted Waykeeper is still required; research alone cannot cast it.

definition.name: Measured rune binding
definition.description: National Arcane Theory for Bound ward. A personally Rune-gifted Waykeeper is still required; wards absorb damage, not casualties already suffered.

definition.name: Flame
definition.description: Personal aptitude for bounded heat and ember workings.

definition.name: Rune
definition.description: Personal aptitude for inscribed bindings and protective workings.

definition.name: Cinder thread
definition.description: A narrow ember working strikes one active enemy formation. Armor reduces its strength damage; a ward absorbs damage first. Costs four strain, at most twice per battle.

definition.name: Bound ward
definition.description: Bind up to eight protective points around one active friendly formation. Protection is consumed by incoming damage and never restores strength or routed morale. Costs three strain, at most twice per battle.

definition.name: Set shields
definition.description: Once per battle, an active Oath guard pays eight fatigue for six damage-absorbing protection. Shield drill does not heal casualties or restore routed morale.

definition.name: Rally the line
definition.description: Once per battle, restore up to twelve morale to the marshal’s surviving formations, capped by their normal morale. Rally does not heal casualties or change the battle’s random stream.

definition.name: Hearth marshal
definition.description: An appointed field commander. Leads the attached army, rallies shaken formations once per battle, and earns experience from its outcomes.

definition.name: Road witness
definition.description: A travelling surveyor who charts terrain from an escorted camp. Surveys preserve geographic knowledge, not the positions of unseen foreign troops.

definition.name: March engineer
definition.description: A field specialist who must travel with an army. Refits replenish real formation losses; siege sabotage trades coin and exposure for damage to defenses.

definition.name: Waykeeper
definition.description: A paid travelling practitioner with personal Flame and Rune aptitude. Researched Cinder thread and Bound ward consume limited battle strain. Occupies a companion slot, not an army command.

definition.name: Survey the frontier
definition.description: Hold the escort in place for two turns to chart terrain within six hexes. Unseen armies remain hidden. Moving or fighting interrupts the work without a refund.

definition.name: Refit the column
definition.description: Hold the column for two turns to restore up to five missing strength per formation. Refit cannot exceed a formation’s normal capacity or recreate a destroyed formation.

definition.name: Undermine the defenses
definition.description: Work from the besieging army for two turns. Success removes thirty siege defense; failure wounds the engineer. Relief, peace or displacement interrupts the operation.

definition.name: Keeper of the line
definition.description: The marshal’s formations gain one armor; Rally restores five additional morale. This permanent specialization excludes Decisive orders.

definition.name: Decisive orders
definition.description: The marshal’s formations gain two additional attack. This permanent specialization excludes Keeper of the line.

definition.name: Patient fieldcraft
definition.description: A surveyor charts one hex farther; an engineer restores two additional strength per formation during refit. Engineers choose this instead of Siege craft.

definition.name: Siege craft
definition.description: Careful preparation lowers the risk of a sabotage failure and wounds. Choose this permanent engineering specialization instead of Patient fieldcraft.

definition.name: Muster rolls
definition.description: Organized formation officers raise this healthy marshal’s command capacity from sixteen to eighteen. Compatible with either specialization and its battlecraft branch.

definition.name: Field orders
definition.description: A practiced chain of officers raises this healthy marshal’s command capacity from eighteen to twenty formations. The command remains vulnerable to the marshal’s wounds or absence.

definition.name: Measured advance
definition.description: Build on Decisive orders: every formation under this healthy marshal gains one more attack. This battlecraft branch can be learned alongside command expansion.

definition.name: Unbroken line
definition.description: Build on Keeper of the line: every formation under this healthy marshal gains one more armor. This battlecraft branch can be learned alongside command expansion.

definition.name: Horizon studies
definition.description: A practiced Road witness extends Patient fieldcraft by another hex, charting terrain within eight hexes. Hidden armies are still not revealed.

definition.name: Column workshops
definition.description: Build on Patient fieldcraft: organized repair parties restore three additional missing strength per formation, for ten in a completed refit. Lost formations cannot be recreated.

definition.name: Sapper watch
definition.description: Build on Siege craft: guarded working parties remove the remaining ten percentage points of sabotage-failure risk. Enemy relief or displacement can still interrupt the operation.

definition.name: Witnessed assault
definition.description: Build on Measured advance: the marshal adds 1 attack and restores 2 more morale with Rally.

definition.name: Last standard
definition.description: Build on Unbroken line: the marshal adds 1 armor and restores 3 more morale with Rally.

definition.name: Route memory
definition.description: Extend Horizon studies with an additional hex of actual survey reach. Unseen armies remain hidden.

definition.name: Far witness
definition.description: The surveyor reads the distant ground through recorded journeys. Adds one further hex to survey missions.

definition.name: Travelling arsenal
definition.description: Develop Column workshops into a travelling stores practice. Refit restores 4 more missing strength per surviving formation; destroyed units stay destroyed.

definition.name: Breach accounts
definition.description: Apply Sapper watch to the survival of the siege column. The engineer adds 1 armor to the escorted formations.

definition.name: Fresh spring
definition.description: Reliable fresh water feeds a worked hex. It does not create a navigable river.

definition.name: Ore seam
definition.description: Exposed mineral seams provide industry and reward careful quarrying.

definition.name: Old growth
definition.description: Ancient woodland preserves living records. Its knowledge remains valuable under managed cutting.

definition.name: Waterlogged ground
definition.description: Saturated ground slows ordinary extraction and field drainage.

definition.name: Peat bed
definition.description: Wet organic beds supply modest fuel; reedworks can use them more effectively.

definition.name: Rich shoals
definition.description: Productive coastal shallows sustain fish and reward a shore fishery.

definition.name: Ashfall glass
definition.description: Vitrified fragments hamper food gathering but preserve evidence of the disputed Ashfall.

projects.name: Hearth Exchange
projects.description: Host a great exchange supported by three settlements with Charter markets and Witness archives. Sustain its full active period; blockades and conquest can interrupt the endeavor. Funding and duration depend on campaign pace.

short.name: Short
short.description: A brief test or skirmish campaign, usually measured in dozens of turns. Early growth and AI strength are unchanged.

standard.name: Standard
standard.description: A full campaign aiming for hundreds of turns, with greater late economic investment and time to oppose public projects. Actual length depends on play.

long.name: Long
long.description: An extended campaign aiming around five hundred turns. Higher late costs and a wider public response window do not increase AI strength.

epic.name: Epic
epic.description: An enduring campaign aiming around a thousand turns. Large late investments and lengthy public projects extend play without changing AI strength.

victory.note: Project base definition uses historical Short prices. Actual quotes use the rules-aware campaign pace. Conquest is not a separate victory predicate.

treatyFamilies: bilateral peace: one-way coin payment plus timed binding truce

abilitiesCountingCaution: 17 personal skills + 1 commander ability + 1 innate unit ability + 2 battle spells are separate registries. The 25 development nodes are investments, not extra activated abilities. 2 arcane discoveries unlock the same 2 battle spells: not 4 independently usable magical effects.

absence.note: Zero counts mean no exported playable registry or canonical command/state found in this bounded audit, not that the words do not exist in lore, art or design documents.

audio.scope: Tracked production apps/*/src and packages/*/src TypeScript/TSX, excluding *.test and *.spec; audio file names checked across all tracked repository files. Not a browser listening test.
